explain.title: How the score works
explain.intro: Fixed rules ({version}), written in one rules file and run as plain code. Same inputs, same list. Not investment advice.
explain.filtersBody: An asset is left out when it fails a pass-or-fail check of your profile (avoid list, markets, volatility cap, market cap floor, traded value, ESG tag as demo data).
explain.scoreBody: Each remaining asset gets four factors from 0 to 100, with fixed weights:
explain.selectionBody: Highest totals first: up to {topN}; at most {perSector} per sector and {maxCrypto, plural, one {# crypto asset} other {# crypto assets}}. The order is the same at every level; only the amount of detail changes.
explain.notScored: Not part of the score: {removed}. Never an input at any stage: {never}. The AI assistant does not pick, rank or score.
